In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
polarized HERA is a very promising instrument to measure the Drell-Hearn sum-rule at high {radical}(Q{sup 2}).
the Drell-Hearn- Gerasimov (DHG) sum rule is not yet proven to be violated, but that there are strong hints that the DHG sum rule is violated.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Drell-Hearn- Gerasimov sum rule is accessible at HERA for a polarized proton target.
the measurement of the spin dependent total photoproduction is possible, however, it will be very difficult and the results will be limited in accuracy.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Drell-Hearn- Gerasimov sum rule can be tested to an accuracy of 20% with a polarized proton beam at HERA.
the Drell-Hearn--Gerasimov sum rule can be tested with a polarized electron beam at HERA.
